scope: A+B+C development corpus, mixed deduplicated; no D/final questions used
units: chars=UTF-16 code units including internal newlines; token estimate is existing bagu heuristic, not provider tokens
paragraph_definition: Nonblank runs excluding frontmatter/headings/fenced code. Lists/tables without blank lines remain one prose unit. Fence blocks measured separately including markers. ATX headings/fences match current strategy syntax, not a complete Markdown AST.
